notes: Partition confirmed across 16 source and 20 target ids.
τοῦ before καλουμένου is `unrepresented`: the article follows its noun, so under rule 31 it would keep only a supplied relativizer, and the ASV writes a bare participial *called* instead.
ἐγγύς → *nigh unto* heads on *nigh*, which rule 71 settles in terms; rule 101 keeps the trailing *unto* on the adverb because the governed name has no determiner an article could anchor.
The supplied *a* is given to ὁδόν, the head of the noun phrase, and not to the possessor σαββάτου (rule 58).
ἔχον is realized by the single adverb *off*, the ASV having recast the participle of distance.
